C1510.title: HarmonyOS AR/VR Data Security and Privacy Protection Practices
C1510.summary: In April 2025, a technical article analyzed the privacy risks of multimodal data collection on AR/VR devices, including the leakage of sensitive information such as IMU motion data, eye-tracking biometrics, and spatial anchors.
